title: pilosella comata
intro: Pilosella comata, commonly known as Woolly Mousetail, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Pilosella comata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in its leaves, flowers, and roots.
